notes.title: 4 endings, 1 system for tracking them
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/0f6d672d81092bd3325a3a1d4a03a543ab002e27.png[/img]

[i]Did you know that Batora: Lost Haven has more than one ending?[/i]

The core of the [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b] experience is not only the combat system based on its dualism, but also the narrative, which with its multi-branching allows the player to be the master of their own destiny. Make the choices you prefer and [b]get to the ending that best suits you[/b], with the possibility of increasing the longevity of the game thanks to the high rate of replay value. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/00f453ce77ac1f4bc98a6a51eca2768861af1e14.gif[/img]

Batora: Lost Haven, in fact, [b]has 4 different endings[/b] and with the latest patch that we released on PC and which will soon be available on consoles as well, we decided to highlight this aspect even more.

[h1]How to recognize narrative branches[/h1]
Every time you have an important choice to make you will have a precise and distinguishable signal on the screen, and sound effects will accompany you in understanding that you are faced with something important. We have also added two essential moments to help you understand how many endings you have unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/75fdc2ad8aed4ffa59e6956fa74a48df124e7d1d.gif[/img]

Once you've finished the game, a [b]pop-up will appear [/b]to tell you how many of the 4 endings you unlocked, reminding you that you still have more to unlock, depending on the number of your runs. Once you're back in the main menu, the one on the initial screen, where you can decide whether to load a game or play a new one, [b]you'll notice some lit-up mandalas on the bottom.[/b]

[h1]How to track unlocked endings[/h1]
We've added 4 mandalas that will light up and color based on how many endings you've unlocked by making your specific choices throughout the game. In this way you will have the possibility to know [b]how many different branches you have taken[/b] and how many times you have to finish the game again, with the aim of unlocking the other endings at your disposal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/7cbbc02493667acbb3bbb118667026dfb8a9ac70.gif[/img]

[b]Let's make a practical example! [/b]During the adventure you will come to unlock one of the 4 endings, making certain choices that will lead you to side with some rather than others (we won't give you spoilers!). At the end of the first run, the mandala in the lower right corner will light up, which will make you understand that you have unlocked the first ending. 

[b]What does it mean?[/b] That you are missing 3 more! The order of the mandalas will always be the same, so there won't be a correspondence between the symbol and the unlocked ending, but simply a numerical sequence.

[i]Had you noticed this? How many endings have you discovered yet?[/i]

notes.title: Limits are over! Let's uncap Batora: Lost Haven.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/b06ffa84799b528eeabbd005328bb5503bdb1c46.png[/img]

We have arrived at the last in-depth analysis dedicated to [b]the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1506440/view/5891302324255933238]21.12 patch[/url][/b] with which we have made important changes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1506440/view/3627118151101566740]not only to the combat system[/url], but also to the first hour of the game, adding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1506440/view/3676659200147787761]total support to Steam Deck[/url] and also going [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1506440/view/3627118151142347281]to add a difficulty selector[/url]. While waiting for the patch to arrive on consoles in the coming weeks, here are more details on the technical improvements made to the PC version of [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Added frame rate uncap[/b] - On PC we unlocked the frames, deciding to play in two different modes. The first with the frame rate locked up to 240fps and with the vertical synchrony active, the second instead expects to be able to play with the unlocked (variable refresh rate), unlimited frame rate, autonomously choosing the fps limiter, but with the v-sync off.

[*] [b]Full Support 21:9 aspect ratio[/b] - On PC, Batora: Lost Haven correctly supports 21:9 (and 16:10) aspect ratio for both user interface and scene rendering.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/2ce484f6407ec51622bf4f2509d9f62ac7137fdc.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Added skip sequences[/b] - you can now skip all the cutscenes you want in order to speed up the gaming experience ([b]especially if you are doing a second run[/b] and have already watched all possible scenes). The dialogues, on the other hand, continue to be skippable manually, one by one. Only the game boot sequence the first time you start Batora: Lost Haven can’t be skipped. 

[*] [b]Full compatibility on Steam Deck [/b]- We have improved the readability of text throughout the game. When starting Batora: Lost Haven, the game runs in fullscreen mode at the [b]native Steam Deck resolution of 1280x800[/b]. Then, all the available features are now active on Batora: Lost Haven: the controller icons are now shown, the in-game interface text is legible and all functionality is accessible using the default controller configuration.
[/list]

This was the [b]latest update on our last patch[/b]. We trust that we have responded to all your feedback and respected all your requests. Our support for Batora: Lost Haven will obviously not end here and in the coming weeks we will continue to [b]keep you updated on the upcoming news[/b] regarding the game.

notes.title: Want a harder challenge? Now you can!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/0da6b01c33cd1915471d66e401cb14936e1e6ec6.png[/img]

You told us that you would have liked a difficulty selector in [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b], so you can choose how to face your adventure with Avril. We have decided to listen to your feedback and insert 3 different degrees of difficulty, so as to allow you to adapt your adventure to your needs. 

We told you about it in our patch notes, but now let's go into more detail! To recover all the additions, you can check our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1506440?emclan=103582791469219169&emgid=5891302324255933238]patch notes[/url].

[i]None of the 3 difficulty modes will affect the acquisition of Trophies and Achievements. [/i]

[b]Before the patch[/b] - Batora: Lost Haven had only one difficulty level and attacks made in one nature (for example, physical) did 100% damage to the opponent of the same nature, instead a special coefficient was used to calculate the damage of the opposite nature, which was much less, but still present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/99f8506b66983b2215666c9021a336490fdf9341.gif[/img]

[b]After the patch[/b] - Now you have the possibility to select your degree of difficulty and consequently go to modify the coefficient that determines the amount of damage inflicted on the opponent of an opposite nature to yours. [b]The mode can be changed at any time by accessing the game menu[/b], therefore not the main menu, and changing the selector. We reiterate that no variation for Trophies and Achievements will occur, but only a greater or lesser difficulty in the fights.

[b]The 3 modes[/b] - It will be possible to select: 
[list]
[*][b]Loose difficulty[/b], in which the difference of colors is canceled and the damage can be done in the same mode and quantity both to the enemy with your same nature and to the opposite. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/d998133c9fcff3136eb1e5dfc5c7ebecbb3a3af3.gif[/img]

[*][b]Standard difficulty[/b], which will be the same as you played until before the patch released on December 20, so with 100% damage to enemies of your own nature and a damage relative to a coefficient for the opposite nature. 

[*][b]Strict difficulty[/b], the highest and most difficult one: you will only damage the corresponding nature, totally canceling the damage inflicted and making the game experience much more complex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/e4d64b151fefb47fa5cb6b3a40a9dfae15a28f1a.gif[/img]
[/list]

Obviously, hybrids, in all modes, [b]will continue to suffer damage in both natures,[/b] as will happen for boss battles, depending on the nature indicated.

In the next few days we will keep giving you more details regarding the main innovations listed in our latest patch notes, so that we can accompany you on a journey to discover [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b]! In the meantime, remember that Batora: Lost Haven is still available at the [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b], available with a 20% discount on the final price until tomorrow!

notes.title: How we’ve improved Batora: Lost Haven’s combat system
notes.content:
The combat system, together with the multi-branching narrative, is certainly the heart of the Batora: Lost Haven experience. Many of you appreciated the idea of dual nature, but we listened to your feedback in this case too by making changes to some aspects, so as to make the whole gameplay more dynamic and also more visually spectacular. Here are the major details regarding the changes made with the latest patch on December 21st.

[list]
[*][b]Intensity Feedback Impact [/b]- Visually we wanted to improve the impact that Avril's sword, or any other blow from her, inflicts on an opponent. Thanks to the Freeze Hit, once a mob is hit, it will suffer a backlash that will lead it to freeze on itself and interrupt the animation, as if it were, in fact, frozen. This aspect, already present in the game, has been enhanced to have a greater visual and more realistic impact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/77388ac2647dbbb1d47c53e8a9e9840562124517.gif[/img]

To make all of this have an even higher value from a visual point of view, we added a more present camera shake: a VFX effect that is generated both in the zoom-in and in the zoom-out view, attacking both physically and mentally. At the same time, the SFX for physical and mental hits has been improved.

[*][b]Attack Queue[/b] - We've already talked about how we implemented a memory system for the combos you're going to perform, but we'll talk about it in more detail now. This means introducing a memory system that remembers the keys you press, no matter what strokes Avril is making. 
Pressing a key, on the other hand, is much faster than the action performed by Avril herself, so you will find yourself making combos with your key combinations that will go faster than how Avril can make her animations. For this reason we have ensured that the system can keep the next action in memory and loop all the animations following your instructions, without losing anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/25664a7b7a6beeb865016903e96c7686e64a60b1.gif[/img]

A practical example: if after dodging we want to hit immediately, the system will remember that you pressed the hit button immediately after the dodge button and will perform the animations in sequence.
[/list]
-

In the next few days we will provide you with more details regarding the main innovations listed in our last patch notes, so that we can accompany you on a journey to discover Batora: Lost Haven!
In the meantime, remember that Batora: Lost Haven is listed in the [b]Steam Winter Sale [/b]and is available with a [b]20% discount on the final price[/b]. One more chance to try out all the changes we've made with this latest patch!

Then, if your support has been invaluable for all the feedback we received that prompted us to make these changes, it will be equally important if [b]you leave a review for Batora: Lost Haven[/b] here on Steam! A welcome gesture that will continue to support our work. With the aim of continuing to improve thanks to your feedback!

notes.title: Massive changes in the first hour of the game: find them all out!
notes.content:
From your feedback, it emerged that the first hour of Batora: Lost Haven did not fully reflect what is the overall adventure which develops in the following hours. For this reason we have been working hard to make the first approach with Avril more dynamic and also [b]to modify the Oniric Arena[/b], following all your indications! 

After our latest post giving you an overview of everything that the new patch introduced, here is a greater detail regarding the changes made in the first hour of the game!
[list]
[*][b]Inside the Oniric Arena[/b] - the first version of the arena allowed you to defeat an enemy with one hit, no matter what nature you were in. Instead, now you will be able to engage in real combat against the enemies in the Arena, to be prepared for what the overall game will be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/6f4eef1da11f922e15263cf2c8265fc4e852e95c.gif[/img]

Avril continues to be immune, therefore she will not suffer hits, but the fight must be carried out on a regular basis, therefore following the options of dualism. 4 to 5 strikes in both physical and mental nature will be required to defeat each enemy! We also decided to remove the skills, which were all initially unlocked, so that Avril can only use basic attacks, as well as in the first few hours of the game.

[*][b]The Oniric Arena[/b] - We have decided to change the appearance and setting of the Oniric Arena as well. We’ve replaced the huge square arena filled with ruins scattered around the perimeter with flying islands in the sky, from which it is possible to observe the planets below. In the background there will be infinity and waterfalls have been added, to enhance the feeling of a dreamlike environment. 

From an art direction point of view, we wanted to recreate an unconscious perception of Batora's power as she is trying to contact Avril. The Oniric Arena becomes, to all intents and purposes, an environment in which [b]space has no limits and time bends and takes shape[/b], so much so that all normal forces lose scientific coherence.
Thus Avril finds herself living an out-of-body experience, which ends up giving her the ability to perceive contact with Batora and see the planets in which she will face her adventure. She hears the screams, feels the power of Sun and Moon, and even understands the endless duel.

[*][b]After the Oniric Arena[/b] - From a gameplay point of view, we have decided to improve the pacing fight, with a balance that increases the duration of the fights, but always leaving you with that sense of power that distinguishes the first hour of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/25664a7b7a6beeb865016903e96c7686e64a60b1.gif[/img]

Immediately after the Oniric Arena, we also decided to balance [b]the first battles on Gryja more[/b], so as to make the gameplay experience more rewarding until the arrival of Carador.

Another aspect that we have decided to enhance is the reduction of tutorials during the game, to streamline the presence of text on the screen and make the gaming experience much more dynamic![/list]

-

In the next few days we will provide you with more details regarding the main innovations listed in our last patch notes, so that we can accompany you on a journey to discover Batora: Lost Haven!
In the meantime, remember that Batora: Lost Haven is listed in the [b]Steam Winter Sale [/b]and is available with a [b]20% discount on the final price[/b]. One more chance to try out all the changes we've made with this latest patch!

Then, if your support has been invaluable for all the feedback we received that prompted us to make these changes, it will be equally important if [b]you leave a review for Batora: Lost Haven[/b] here on Steam! A welcome gesture that will continue to support our work. With the aim of continuing to improve thanks to your feedback!

notes.title: Discover the biggest Batora: Lost Haven patch so far!
notes.content:
Christmas is approaching and we have decided to give you our personal gift: a huge update for [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b], with numerous contents based on your feedback, that will improve your gaming experience and make you want to relive Avril's interplanetary adventure once again! Or, in case you have yet to try it, find out what we thought for you.

Here's all the news from [b]our latest Christmas patch[/b], available today on PC and soon also on consoles!

[h1]Gameplay improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Improved first hour of the game [/b]- following your suggestions, we improved the Oniric Arena both in terms of balance and the proposed tutorials, which are now to a lesser extent

[*][b]Improved impact intensity feedback of the combat system[/b] - to enhance the visual impact of the combat, we improved the freeze hit both visually and concretely, to make the mob freeze for an instant after being hit; we have also improved the camera shake, the shaking that allows you to receive feedback when the enemy is hit; sounds have been fixed to enhance the SFX on impact. We also added a slow-mo VFX at the end of a fight when the last enemy is defeated while in direct zoom camera on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/8d85321f956c8663c556317489204912e03c71f4.gif[/img]

[*][b]Improved combat system[/b] - to ensure that you can ring combos quickly and avoid having to wait for the animation for the second hit, now the system remembers the keys you pressed before Avril can perform the actions. If you pressed dodge immediately after the hit that has not yet been inflicted, the system will remember the sequence you entered and execute the moves one after the other. We also sped up the first attack of a physical combo.

[*][b]Pacing Improvement[/b] - to make the gameplay more varied and raise the level of challenge, we have increased the presence of hybrids, so as to increment the presence of mid-bosses throughout the game. We have also included hazards, and traps that make exploration more challenging, including spikes that come out of the ground, flames that come out of the walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/77388ac2647dbbb1d47c53e8a9e9840562124517.gif[/img]

[*][b]Difficulty selector added[/b] - to allow you to choose the degree of difficulty to face the adventure and adapt it in the best possible way to your needs and abilities, you can now select 3 different difficulty levels - Loose, Standard, and Strict. With the two new modes, you can decide how challenging you want your experience to be. The selector will activate after the third game mission, making the start the same for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/f60b2c1b49625aa1927d01dd715606becd43a1d7.gif[/img]

[*][b]Added indicator for earned endings[/b] - to help you better understand your progression level in the game, and also the endings you’ve unlocked, at the end of the game the system will clearly tell you which of the 4 endings you have unlocked. Furthermore, in the initial menu, mandalas will appear which will light up according to the unlocked ending, so as to let you know which you've already experienced and how many you can still try!

[*][b]Added indicators to enhance the choices[/b] - to highlight the importance of certain dialogues and choices, and help you understand which are the narrative crossroads that will condition your story, we enlarged the texts of the "Important Choices" and added a specific icon to the important choices, to accentuate the conqueror and defender paths[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/75fdc2ad8aed4ffa59e6956fa74a48df124e7d1d.gif[/img]

[h1]Technical Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Added frame rate uncap [/b]- to allow you the best possible experience and also the greatest customization from a technical point of view on PC, now you can unlock frames and also select v-sync on PC, selecting the limit of the framerate you prefer and decide whether to play with active v-sync or with variable refresh rate.

[*] [b]Added full 21:9 support[/b] - all resolutions have been added for both UI and scene rendering, now compatible with all aspect ratios on PC, both 16:10 and 21:9, in a range from 1280x720 to 3840x2160. 

[*] [b]Added skip sequences[/b] - if you don’t want to listen to all the dialogues during the game, but only the most important ones in the cutscenes, you can now skip any sequence, except the game boot sequence the first time you start Batora: Lost Haven. The dialogues cannot be skipped automatically, but always manually.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/b53af4a3272b5358d583b2fbd34ff6744fbdb24a.gif[/img]

[list][*] [b]Improved Steam Deck Compatibility[/b] - We have improved the readability of text throughout the game. When starting Batora: Lost Haven, the game runs in fullscreen mode at the native Steam Deck resolution of 1280x800.

[*] [b]More various bugs fixed[/b]
Rebalanced health and defense of companions in NG+
Fixed issues where the player could get stuck in some game environments
Improved NPC spawn animations
The game automatically launches in Windowed Fullscreen when on Steam Big Picture Mode[/list]

In the next few days, we will provide you with more details regarding the main innovations listed in this patch note, so that we can accompany you on a journey to discover all the ways your feedback has helped us improve Batora: Lost Haven!

notes.title: Don't settle for a run: jump into the New Game+
notes.content:
[h2]The story of Avril does not stop at the first run: the multi branching allows you to go and discover everything that Batora: Lost Haven can give you![/h2]

Let's start by saying that once you have finished your first run and defeated the final boss, which will be different depending on what you have chosen to do during your adventure, the [b]New Game +[/b] will be unlocked in the main title.

[h3]New Game +, what do you bring with you[/h3]

Batora: Lost Haven will start from the beginning and give you the chance to make the choices you didn't make in your first run. The UI will also come to meet you by indicating the choices you have decided to take earlier, so as to suggest what to do to change the course of events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/43e1aa6681ec782a4ae16a3abe2395ea5e70574f.png[/img]

In this new adventure [b]you will keep your level[/b] and take with you the runes obtained from the quests, but not those that can be purchased in the shops. [b]All skills will be unlocked immediately[/b], which allows us to increase the level of difficulty.

In the event that you have reached the final boss by reaching the level cap of 25, in the New Game+ you will have [b]the opportunity to reach level 30[/b], with the progression that will be optimized and slowed down compared to the first run. [b]All mobs will follow your level[/b], so as to adapt the level of challenge and avoid that you can find yourself being too performing compared to your opponents.

[h3]The functioning of the runes in the NG +[/h3]

Starting the New Game + with all the skills available and also all the rune points on your side ([url=https://www.batora.game/2022/07/28/growth-system-runes-mechanics-batora-lost-haven/]do you remember how the rune system works?[/url]) will be useful to go to work on [b]an optimization speech of your build[/b], enhancing Avril with some tweaks which will be fundamental to face the second run. 

So if, for example, you have equipped a rune that increases the attack value by two points, but you still have some rune points to spend, you can buy the one that gives three more points of attack and equip it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/0038078c3debea0565c60eebde9422cb413fa733.gif[/img]

We remind you that Batora: Lost Haven [b]has two different final bosses[/b], depending on your choices, and two crossroads choices for each planet: [b]there are 4 endings[/b] in total and it is up to you to discover them all, to be able to truly consider yourself completists of the universe of Batora: Lost Haven.

Have you already had the opportunity to tell us your opinion on Batora: Lost Haven? Remember to leave a review on Steam to continue supporting us!

notes.title: Improvements available in the new Batora: Lost Haven patch
notes.content:
It's been almost 3 weeks since [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b] launched, and we are so happy that it has been received so well from the community! 

We promised you that we would continue to work to make [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b] even better and follow all your directions to thank you for your support, listening to your feedback, which has been essential to improve the gaming experience.

Here we are, then, ready to announce a patch that will allow you to live an ever better gaming experience and continue enjoying [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b] in the best possible way.

[list]
[*] [b]"Meaningful choices" are now clearer[/b] - from the point of view of the UI we have inserted a golden halo to better identify the narrative junctions during which to make key decisions for the continuation of the story. The golden halo will begin to pulsate when one of the two choices you are going to make will prove to be fundamental for the development of the plot of your future.

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/ed99a2a4efbd9dd6d55baa6ea79ebec8/tenor.gif?itemid=27067605[/img]

[*][b]Improved Achievements / Trophies obtaining [/b]- on Xbox it is now possible to correctly unlock Queen of Greenfield Achievements; on PlayStation 5 we have improved the localization of the activity cards in Italian.

[*][b]Improved performance and stability on Consoles and PCs [/b]- we have reduced the possible crashes of the game by increasing the stability of the build, in addition we have also reduced the possibility of running into blocking problems that could compromise the fluidity of the game. From a performance point of view, we have made the framerate more stable.

[*][b]Improved the input of the controls when playing with gamepad[/b] - We changed the default key mapping that allowed Avril to interact with the environment, so as not to interfere with other game mechanics. Now the interaction takes place with the Square button on PlayStation and X on Xbox, while it was previously located on Triangle button on PlayStation and Y on Xbox. The possibility remains for the players to remap the keys and choose the preferred combination. Also in this area we have improved the auto-aim, to allow you to have a better assisted aim in hitting enemies and environmental objects, such as crystals to recover energy.

[*][b]Improved audio quality[/b] - now you can enjoy a better and smoother audio experience, thanks to improved synchronization between audio and cutscenes. We have also added the general volume slider on the console, for a single, more immediate adjustment, so as to allow you to manage all the audio tracks in a single solution.

[*][b]Improved combat system in New Game and New Game + [/b]- we rebalanced the effects of attacks and damages, skills and behaviour of Avril, her companions and some NPCs, to make fights more fluid and satisfying, both in NG and NG+. This also applies to some boss fights deemed too difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/43e1aa6681ec782a4ae16a3abe2395ea5e70574f.png[/img]

[*][b]Improved User Interface in the game menus and in-game [/b]- now, in New Game +, you can clearly see the narrative choices you made during the first run, so that you can create different paths and discover new narrative implications.

[*][b]VFX, textures and environments[/b] - we improved all these elements by making them smoother to enhance your overall visual experience.

[*][b]Improved physics for Avril and NPCs[/b] - Interactions with the environment, both for Avril and the NPCs, are now smoother and more fluid.

[*][b]Improved dialogues and texts[/b] - we improved the codex’s fruibility by making it easier to scroll; we fixed some typos in Japanese, German, English, and Italian; we also enhanced the synchronization between dialogues and the corresponding subtitles to make the overall experience more enjoyable.

[*]In the next few days, an even more substantial patch will arrive that will improve your gaming experience even more, based again on your feedback and recommendations. 

Don't forget to continue reviewing the game on Steam and leave a comment on our last game -  it really means the world to us!

[/list]

notes.title: Batora: Lost Haven October Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/6d2cda418f8e9640c37c4809ef5ef23e30846bf7.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Keeper of Balance! [/h1]

[b]The release date of Batora: Lost Haven is very close, so it’s time to reveal some new updates that you will find in the final version of the gameplay,  to explain to you what you are going to play.[/b]

[h2]Level Up and minor update[/h2]

[b]A new level-up reward[/b] - In our last update, we explained to you how to get a level-up in Batora: Lost Haven, but the time has come to tell you that we have decided to include the possibility not only to recharge both the HP bars of your life completely, but also to [b]introduce an area of damage[/b] around Avril that pushes enemies away from her. 

Leveling up thus becomes a really strategic asset within the combat system, which allows you not only to gain some healing, but also to take advantage of a second of stasis during very tight fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/06dea4a3c2143da24501199c57d1db7777602e90.gif[/img]

[b]Exploration reward[/b] - In addition to this level-up change, we have also decided to[b] improve the rewards that are granted by exploration.[/b] Now you have the opportunity to find runes in chests scattered around the environment so as in puzzles. 

[b]Fireflies speed increased[/b] - Among the exploration updates you will also notice that we increased the speed of the fireflies, to prevent Avril from overtaking them when you found yourself asking for a suggestion on the direction to take. Fireflies can be summoned to your support to show you the way to go to reach the next objective of the current mission.

[h2]Hybrid enemies and skill enhancements[/h2]

[b]Hybrid Enemies[/b] - We have placed a lot more emphasis on hybrid enemies. We are talking about opponents who must be fought both with the mental form and with the physical form, because they are vulnerable to both and not just one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/0baa0c8b850f3b1ba1bde10800bed97ffac54339.png[/img]

With this update, hybrids [b]are promoted to the role of real mini-bosses [/b]and you will often find them defending dungeons within which puzzles to complete to advance in the game are hidden. A mechanic that will allow you to test your combat skills and then concentrate more on the logic required by solving the next environmental puzzle.

[b]Mental and Physical Shield edits[/b] - We improved the [b]AI ​​of all your opponents [/b]and at the same time some of Avril's abilities, to allow combat to be more dynamic and engaging. 

Let's start by saying that the mental shield was previously only blocking bullets, but now it is able to block any type of attack. As for the physical shield, we increased the defense value, although it is not yet able to totally cancel the damage.

[h2]Combo system changes[/h2]

Here, however, is the news that we most wanted to tell you about, because we have made some important improvements to the combo system. There will no longer be just one combo to unleash when you use your normal attack, but more sequences. 

Let's take an example based on the physical form: you will have your basic attack combo triggered by pressing the X button three times (in reference to an Xbox controller, or the Square button on a PlayStation console), or you have a different combo if you use the right stick of your controller. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/d7af48ca465038b6ca0d44c75b6a1b298e12b46b.gif[/img]

Instead of three normal blows, you will have [b]a regular blow followed by a lunge attack that will allow you to dash forward[/b] and decrease the gap with the opponent, from that moment, you can press the X button to deliver a sweep attack.

Within this system, another mechanism is also present, but this time[b] based on timing instead of input method[/b]. In fact, while attacking with the X button, if before the third blow you wait a little longer before pressing the action button again, a visual effect will be activated that will allow you to use another attack instead of the sweep, making Avril do a jump in the air with the sword and then land performing an area damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/a999d442947e5e34ee86498a4e3e3cb4858914a8.gif[/img]

Using the same keys, therefore, according to your needs and learning to master the combo system at its best, you will be able to attack in different ways, so to change your offensive strategy and maximize results.

---

We can't wait to let you try this new combo system and to continue to tell you all the news of [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b]!

Did this system intrigue you? Would you like to know more? Do you know we have a Discord channel that you can join and talk to the team whenever you want?

Remember to add [b]Batora: Lost Haven[/b] to your wishlist on Steam to not miss any updates regarding our project and to know all the news on the upcoming release!

notes.title: The rune mechanics in Batora: Lost Haven
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Keeper of Balance! [/h1]

[b]In our last blog post we went to the discovery of all the updates about Batora: Lost Haven, but now it’s time to focus on what concerns the gameplay and some of the features related to it, specifically about the level up system and the rune mechanics.[/b]

We already know that in Batora: Lost Haven the action component will be very important, but today we want to focus on what will be the features related to the RPG: not only the level up system, but also the functioning of the runes, which will allow us to customize even more Avril and make our combat system even more layered.

[h2]How to Level Up[/h2]

Let’s start with the level up system, which is based on the accumulation of EXP points based on how many opponents we are going to defeat. Each mob will give you a specific amount of EXP points, which will allow you to level up even during a fight with a horde. We wanted to make it much more hardcore and block HP recovery as you level up: your stats will change, but you can’t rely on level up to recover energy. Keep this in mind! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/a05073ab61dbb20f6d3729dbf3747655a46cae81.gif[/img]
Avril’s level up

Obviously, in addition to defeating the monsters, Avril will be able to complete the main missions to accumulate EXP points and level up. We have already mentioned that Avril’s attributes will increase, so we specify that you will have both a physical and mental increase: HP and base attack value to start. The level up, however, will also bring another very important change from the point of view of the combat system: it will provide you with a new neutral rune point. And this allows us to enter the topic of the runes.

[h2]The runes mechanics[/h2]

Avril will always have the same weapons with her: to be able to customize them, and to also be able to customize Avril, we will have to rely on the runes. These will be both neutral and linked to the orientation of the protagonist, that can be both a defender and a conqueror. What do they mean? We will see it in more detail later. For now, just know that based on your karma you will accumulate rune points that will follow your balance, whether it is conqueror or defender, thus unlocking the possibility of equipping specific runes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/ec9a2780fc872c9eab27da60baa51ae6d6f8b17e.png[/img]
The Inventory with our runes equipped


A neutral rune will bring you only bonuses and no malus, but the former will be contained from the point of view of the advantages provided. With a Defender rune, however, as well as with a Conqueror, you will have a bonus which will correspond to a malus. Do you want some examples?

[b]Conqueror Rune[/b]: + 10% Critic Rate, -5% Mental Defense
[b]Defender Rune[/b]: + 10% Mental Defense, -5% Physical Defense

Then, each planet you visit will unlock new abilities. Avril begins her adventure, starting with basic attack and dodging, then she will learn the first pair of skills and so on, from planet to planet, for a gradual progression. In this phase of growth the runes will be fundamental, which will also add effects on the skills unlocked. Do you want some examples?

[h2]The Natural Boost[/h2]

After the first planet you will unlock an ability called Natural Boost, a mechanic that will enhance some of your abilities. When you unlock the shield, which will allow you to reflect the hits, with the right rune equipped during the Natural Boost (the rune called “Frangar, Non Flectar”) it will be possible to create an area behind the shield that will activate a recover of your HP, so you can not only reflect the blows of your opponents, but also find a moment of serenity to soothe your wounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/c18cd3039aeb9b553dfa1521cdc27d4e6106e6bf.png[/img]
Frangar, Non Flectar – the shield ability improved by Natural Boost


It will be up to you to decide how to deal with your equipment and how to customize Avril, depending on your way of playing and how you are facing the adventure. This type of customization allowed us to avoid entering a skill tree that forced you to unlock skills that you would not have used with the sole aim of getting to unlock the next one. In Batora: Lost Haven you will have total flexibility in customizing Avril and your fighting style, creating a build that will satisfy you in all respects. Ensuring balance in the build is our priority from a gameplay point of view.

We can’t wait to be able to show you all the runes that you will have available in your inventory and let you find out how many mixes you could make thanks to this deep and customizable combat system. 

Did this system intrigue you? Would you like to know more? Do you know we have a Discord channel that you can join and talk to the team whenever you want?

Remember to add Batora: Lost Haven to your wishlist on Steam to not miss any updates regarding our project and to know all the news on the upcoming release!

notes.title: Batora: Lost Haven July Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/13d52fd9a05c1df5905f793e66281168f4c8ff02.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Keeper of Balance! [/h1]

[b]We are getting closer and closer to the definitive release of Batora: Lost Haven (announced for this fall) and to allow you to have a new taste of the work we are carrying out we have decided to update our PC demo! Check out all the updates we have done for this new version of the Batora: Lost Haven demo.[/b]

[h2]Updates since the last Demo[/h2]

[b]Tutorial layout improvements[/b]
Let's start by saying that we have improved the layout of the tutorials, so as to make it much more intuitive! A way to allow you to enter the world of Batora: Lost Haven in the best possible way. 

[b]Redesigned UI and GUI[/b]
Along with the tutorial improvements you will find a new UI, redesigned to allow you to have an easier reading for all data, easier navigation and also an improvement of the shop screen, now more intuitive and with the data shown in a clearer way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/2295d470588726dd95c94a8eecdc21c2963fd8bc.jpg[/img]
[b][In the first screen you can see the old UI, in the second one the new one][/b]

Together with the UI, we also improved the GUI, with an easier to read lifebar and dynamic indications with the buttons on the screen: we have decided to show you only those that can be activated in the current mode, to optimize space on the screen.

[b]A new Zoom system[/b]
The aspect that we were most interested in improving, however, was related to the zoom in game. As many of you pointed out that it would be great to be able to zoom on the beautifully detailed environments, the view is now much closer to Avril and what is happening, allowing you to enjoy greater detail and proximity to the action. While maintaining the isometric view, therefore, we were able to find a solution that allows you to be more focused on the action. The new system allows you to adjust the camera choosing between two zoom modes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/d8869db7436b3f0492f76540b88520e11f28579c.jpg[/img]
[b][In the first screen you can see the zoom out system, then in the second one you can see the zoom in system][/b]

[b]New loading screens and balancing[/b] 
Along with the performance and visual effects improvements, we've added new artwork to the loading screens and fine-tuned the balance. To close, the combat system has improved basic attack combos thanks to more precise controls in the mental mode.


[h2]How to play the demo?[/h2]

[b]Have you already played the demo?[/b] Just start the Steam client to automatically start the update to the new version. 

[b]Have you already played the demo but uninstalled it?[/b] You can download the demo again and the updated version will be installed directly on your PC!

[b]Do you want to try the demo?[/b] Sign up for our newsletter and take advantage of all the benefits we offer to our subscribers, including having a preview of all the latest news and the ability to access exclusive content.

Thanks to these new updates, playing the [b]new demo of Batora: Lost Haven[/b] will allow you to [b]live a new experience[/b], more faithful to what will be the final version of the game. notes.title: Batora: Lost Haven Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello, Keepers of Balance!

As time goes by and you’ve already had two chances to try the game - last Summer’s Closed Alpha and the most recent Demo during February’s Steam Next Fest, and each time you helped us by filling out some quite detailed feedback forms that contributed to the game’s improvement, it’s only fair that we share with you the details of how the game has improved since the closed alpha and what we’ll keep doing to improve it until it launches, later this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/412ad2e0f0402e39be0e56ea60b75131a2c7a07f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Updates since the Closed Alpha[/h2]

Last Summer’s Closed Alpha was the first real taste of Batora: Lost Haven for players. Over 23k gamers got a key to try it and the response was AMAZING!

Seeing how many people played and enjoyed it made us super proud, especially since you appreciated it so much even at such an early stage of development.

That time, your feedback was extremely helpful as it pointed out some issues that we were aware of and some that made it clearer what kind of game you envisioned Batora: Lost Haven to be.

So, besides overall performance enhancement - remember that it was in alpha stage - following are the main updates we implemented since the Closed Alpha:

[b]Camera system and navigability[/b]
As some users pointed out that the camera movements would cause motion sickness, we improved the camera system and level design for a better level legibility

[b]Enhanced controls (focusing on keyboard and mouse)[/b]
We improved the animation system, the combo windows, and overall responsiveness of the controls 

[b]Impact on physical hits[/b]
We introduced the camera shake and freeze on hit and improved the attacks’ VFX to ensure that physical hits would give the right “impact” feeling

[b]Progression feedback[/b]
We improved the in-game notification system and the VFX for level-up and acquired items, to highlight in a more incisive way whenever players reach a new level or get runes or new skills

[b]Strategic combat boost[/b]
We improved the combat system in terms of AI and skills to make it more fun and strategically interesting

[b]Enemy spawn system[/b]
We improved the enemies’ spawn system to allow management of specific spawn points, increasing the fights’ variety and making them more “choreographic”

[b]New improved puzzles[/b]
We re-designed puzzles and VFX to be more accessible and clear; we also improved control sharpness

[b]New companions mechanics[/b]
We made the companion a part of the gameplay, so it now has an active role in fights too


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/f3f8d4f24a042936702d7d8bdfd7b422aa447c41.jpg[/img]

[h2]Work-in-progress updates for final release[/h2]
Then there was the Steam Next Fest: one intense week during which Steam users got to play the demo of Batora: Lost Haven and give us their feedback once again.

We’ve already started working on the new updates so that, as we head towards launch, everything will be ready and functional.

Here are the main features we’re working on:

[b]Zoom system[/b]
As many players pointed out that it would be great to be able to zoom on the beautifully detailed environments, we are implementing a system that allows players to adjust the camera choosing between 2 zoom modes 

[b]Pad controls[/b]
We’re improving the control system to make it more accurate and responsive to the player’s intentions, consistently adapting to the different control systems

[b]Reworked UI & menus[/b]
We re-designed the menus to make them clearer for players, showing relevant information and making it more accessible

[b]Codex[/b]
Players specifically asked to delve into the game’s plot and backstory, so they will now get to collect the codex pages while playing, thus learning more about the game’s lore

[b]New tutorials[/b]
We’re re-designing the tutorials to make them readable on all platforms. Players will be able to access them through the codex after unlocking them in-game.

[b]Full control customization[/b]
We’ll give users the possibility to customize the controls choosing their favorite bindings

[b]Rune stats[/b]
We’re improving the rune system, making their effects more impactful and remarkable 

[b]Improved health bars status[/b]
We’re adding a “semi-death” status to alert players when one or both of their health bars are below 20%

[b]Dubbing[/b]
As players were not convinced about some of the dubbing, we’re going to replace some actors - including Batora! - choosing the most appropriate ones for their roles

[b]Super detailed world-building[/b]
We’re adding more dialogs based on the players’ choices and their consequences - for example, characters and NPCs will talk in real-time commenting on what’s happening in the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/99d40b17bf0c9b21f634f8a435781452fd33a75e.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Did you play Closed Alpha or Next Fest Demo of Batora: Lost Haven? Leave a comment and let us know what you thought![/i][/b]

Be sure to add Batora: Lost Haven to your Steam Wishlist to keep up to date with news, and don’t forget to tell your friends too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1506440/Batora_Lost_Haven/

notes.title: Nature Switch Update!
notes.content:
Today, we want to show you how we updated the game’s switch mechanic! 

The Nature Switch requires you to strategically switch between physical and mental mode according to the enemy you face, affecting both the aesthetic as well as the gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39697761/8cd5790bef8499c71026dd23bcb05b760b9f7d51.gif[/img]

Well, we decided to spice it up a little bit more by adding switching effects: now, when switching from mental to physical, enemies will be attracted towards Avril to ease melee attacks, whereas when switching from physical to mental, they will be pushed away to help you fight back!

[b]Wishlist now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1506440/Batora_Lost_Haven/?snr=1_5_1100__1100
